 Join a high-performing, technology-driven organisation operating in a fast-paced, cloud-first environment where network infrastructure plays a critical role in business success. With ongoing investment into modern networking and cloud capabilities, the business is continuously evolving its platforms to support growth, performance, and security at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative infrastructure team that works closely with engineering groups and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions. 
   Your new role     
 As a Network Engineer, you'll contribute to the ongoing support and enhancement of a complex network environment spanning LAN, WAN, MAN, cloud, and externally facing systems. Working alongside senior engineers, you'll help maintain a stable, high-performing network while also supporting new initiatives and improvements. 
   
 You'll be involved in implementing monitoring and automation to strengthen operational resilience, as well as supporting secure and scalable connectivity across cloud and on-prem platforms. The role offers a balance of BAU responsibilities and project work, giving you exposure to both day-to-day operations and broader infrastructure uplift initiatives.

 Hands-on experience with Cisco and Fortinet technologies across switching, routing, and firewalls (including VDOMs), along with exposure to BGP, VPNs, multicast, and related protocols

ABOUT US:
Mizar Partners Pty Ltd is an Australian professional accounting and business advisory firm with offices in Melbourne and Sydney. We provide accounting, taxation, compliance and business advisory services to individuals, sole traders, small and medium-sized businesses, and corporate clients across a wide range of industries.
Our services include bookkeeping, management accounting, taxation, tax planning, business advisory, cash flow management, SMSF support, entity structure advice, financial reporting and compliance support. We focus on providing practical accounting and taxation solutions to help clients maintain accurate financial records, meet their statutory obligations, understand their financial position and make informed business decisions.
Vacant Position: Senior Accountant 
We are seeking an experienced Accountant to join our senior level service team on a full-time basis. The successful applicant will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, analysing financial and taxation information for clients, assisting with statutory compliance, preparing financial statements and tax returns, supporting business advisory work, and providing professional accounting support across a range of client matters.
This role is suited to a professional with strong technical knowledge in accounting, taxation, financial reporting, business compliance, accounting systems, budget analysis, cash flow management and client advisory services.
Hiring Type: Permanent Full-time
Salary Range: Above AUD82,000 + super/ per year 
(The remuneration will depend on the skills, outcomes and experience you can deliver. )
Working Location: Melbourne
Qualification Requirements:
•	Above Master’s degree from Australia or overseas tertiary education provider is a must;
•	Must have a minimum of 3 years’ relevant accounting experience in public practice or business services.
•	Strong communication skills required, including proficiency in English and Mandarin.
•	Hands-on public practice experience delivering end-to-end tax, BAS and financial reporting services for Australian SME.
•	In-depth working knowledge of ATO legislation, payroll compliance, FBT, GST, PAYG and superannuation regulatory rules.
•	Strong proficiency with cloud accounting platforms and advanced Excel for financial modelling and reconciliation.
•	CPA/CA qualified or currently undertaking professional accounting accreditation will highly regarded.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian taxation law and compliance requirements.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills to deliver straightforward financial advice to non- 
financial business owners.
•	Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

Roles and Responsibility:
This is a senior level accounting service role, with core duties including:
?	Conduct payroll reviews fully compliant with ATO standards, including superannuation contribution calculations and salary packaging deduction audits.
?	Prepare month-end accounting deliverables: cash flow statements, journal entries, ad-hoc performance reports, monthly budgets, balance sheets and formal management reporting packs.
?	Prepare, reconcile and lodge all compliance documentation including Business Activity Statements (BAS), individual, company, partnership and super fund tax returns covering GST, PAYG instalments, PAYG withholding and all statutory tax obligations.
?	Design, update and refine internal financial workflows and general accounting procedures to boost operational efficiency and accuracy.
?	Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support for cloud-based accounting software systems used by internal teams and SME clients.
?	Compile complete financial statements (balance sheet, profit & loss, cash flow statements), conduct line-by-line account reviews and general ledger reconciliations, and deliver profitability, liquidity and financial health analysis to firm management and directors.
?	Prepare, validate and submit accurate annual Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) filings for all client entities.
?	Deliver customised professional taxation and structural advice to clients covering business setup,     
growth planning and daily operational financial optimisation.
?	Build robust financial control frameworks to protect client asset integrity, analyse operational expenses and track organisational income and expenditure trends.
?	Serve as the primary liaison for external auditors and support interim and year-end statutory audit procedures for all client portfolios.
?	Correspond and negotiate directly with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) and other financial regulatory authorities as required for client compliance matters.
?	Identify legitimate tax minimisation opportunities, eligible claim deductions and profit-improvement strategies for individual and business clients.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 






We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 






As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 






Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


Are you currently part of the team at Monash Health? Use your network login to access the Monash Health Careers portal and discover all the job opportunities open to you, to support growing your career within the organisation.




To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.

Shape how digital change is experienced across one of Australia's largest health services.



About the Service


The Design and Architecture Services Department provides strategic architectural leadership across Monash Health, ensuring digital investments, systems and solutions align with organisational priorities and deliver long-term value. Working closely with clinical, operational and technology stakeholders, the team guides technology strategy, solution design, portfolio management and architectural governance to create a connected, sustainable and future-ready digital ecosystem that supports exceptional patient care and service delivery.



About The Role


If appointed to this business-critical role, you'll provide strategic leadership across enterprise architecture, technology governance, solution design and application portfolio management. 


Leading a team of architects and technical specialists, and reporting to the Director, Digital Applications and Architecture, you'll be responsible for defining the future-state architecture for one of Australia's largest and most complex health services, ensuring digital investments align with clinical, operational and organisational priorities. Working closely with executive leaders, clinicians, technology teams and external partners, you'll establish architecture standards, guide major technology decisions and shape a connected, sustainable and future-ready digital ecosystem.


Success in the role will be measured across four key areas: 



Development and delivery of Monash Health's future-state architecture and technology roadmaps


Establishment of architecture governance, standards and design assurance practices


Application portfolio management, rationalisation and lifecycle planning 


Excellence in stakeholder engagement and development of trusted partnerships across clinical, operational and digital teams



This is a Full Time, ongoing role, based in our hybrid workplace. The importance of connection and relationship development across the business cannot be underestimated and you'll happily work on a Monash Health site at least half of your working week to support your team and drive this important work. Travel across Monash Health sites will be required.



About You


You're a strategic technology leader who sees the bigger picture and brings others on the journey. You recognise that great architecture is about more than technology, it's about aligning digital investments with organisational priorities, enabling innovation, managing risk and creating sustainable foundations for the future.


Equally comfortable influencing executives, collaborating with clinicians and working alongside technical teams to solve complex challenges, you have a strong background in enterprise architecture, digital transformation and technology strategy. In addition, you bring proven ability to translate organisational objectives into pragmatic roadmaps, standards and governance frameworks that deliver measurable value.


An inspiring leader, you build trust readily, creating alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and developing high performing teams. Combining strategic thinking with practical delivery, you're passionate about designing technology ecosystems that improve outcomes for clinicians, consumers and the broader health service.


What you'll bring:



Significant leadership experience in enterprise architecture, technology strategy, solution architecture or digital transformation within a large, complex organisation


Strong understanding of modern architecture practices, including cloud platforms, integration patterns, APIs, data ecosystems security, risk and compliance


Demonstrated experience developing architecture roadmaps, governance frameworks, standards and design assurance practices that support strategic technology investment


Proven success leading high-performance specialist teams and navigating organisational change within complex or highly regulated environments


Exceptional communication, stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across executive, clinical, operational and technical environments



Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Computer Science, Digital Health or a related discipline will be highly regarded.



Why Join Design and Architecture Services at Monash Health


Take advantage of a rare opportunity to shape and influence enterprise-wide technology strategy, drive digital transformation and play a key role in enabling the delivery of safer, connected and more sustainable healthcare. Working at the intersection of clinical care, technology and innovation, you'll help create smarter digital solutions that improve patient outcomes and support the clinicians who deliver them every day




At Monash Health, you will:




Work within a values-driven, purpose-led organisation 


Be part of a connected network of clinical, academic and system leaders 


Help drive innovation, inclusion and better health outcomes





We offer:




The opportunity to make a real impact on patient experience


A supportive, collaborative team environment


Ongoing learning and development opportunities


The chance to be part of Victoria's largest public health service




For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Victoria Hornidge, Director, Digital Applications, on 0425 728 838

Our Culture and Values 






At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement. 






Our teams play a critical role in bringing our new strategy to life, challenging traditional approaches, embracing innovation,

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd, a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder, is looking for an experienced full-time Software Developer with a background in the logistics industry. You will build the systems that run our forwarding and customs operations, working hands-on with CargoWise, Expedient and modern AI tooling.

About the Company

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd is a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder with our Australian operations based in Brisbane. Technology sits at the centre of how we operate: we invest in automation, systems integration and practical AI to streamline forwarding and customs workflows, connect with partners and carriers, and deliver a faster, more accurate service to our customers. You will join an on-site team where your work goes straight into daily operations.

About the Role

This is a standalone role for a capable all-rounder who will oversee the technological advancement of the business. You will own our technology roadmap end to end: developing, testing, maintaining and documenting application code in line with user requirements and system and technical specifications, building integrations with our CargoWise and Expedient platforms, and embedding AI across our operations. You will work directly with the leadership team and operational staff, with the autonomy to choose the right tools and set the technical direction.

Key Responsibilities

•	Research, consult and analyse user, business and system requirements, and evaluate existing systems to identify deficiencies and recommend improvements.
•	Design, develop, test, debug, document and maintain program code in accordance with user requirements and system and technical specifications.
•	Build and maintain integrations with CargoWise (eAdapter, APIs, EDI, workflow and registry configuration) and Expedient, including data mapping, message handling and automation.
•	Develop and deploy AI-driven features such as document extraction, classification and workflow automation for logistics operations.
•	Write and maintain technical documentation, program specifications and test plans.
•	Support deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines and operational monitoring of production systems.
•	Identify and address security risks across the product lifecycle.
•	Advise leadership on technology strategy, evaluate emerging tools and platforms, and drive the company's digital roadmap.
•	Train and support operational staff in adopting new systems and AI tooling.


About You 

•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or at least 1-2 years of relevant professional experience with strong working knowledge of forwarding, customs and transport operations across air, sea and road.
•	Hands-on experience with CargoWise, including workflow configuration, eAdapter/API integration, EDI messaging or custom development.
•	Demonstrated experience developing with or integrating Expedient freight forwarding and customs software.
•	Experience building AI-enabled software with LangChain and with the models and APIs of all the modern frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and xAI), including intelligent document processing and workflow automation in production systems.
•	Strong experience with AWS for hosting, deployment and cloud services.
•	Strong proficiency in one or more modern languages and frameworks (e.g. Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node, SQL) and experience with REST APIs and EDI.
•	The self-direction to operate as the sole technical resource in the business, managing priorities and delivering without day-to-day technical supervision.
•	Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational logistics requirements into robust technical solutions.

What We Offer

•	Salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.
•	Real ownership of the systems you build, in a business applying AI to day-to-day freight operations.
•	A collaborative on-site team environment in Brisbane.
•	Ongoing professional development, including support for CargoWise certifications and AI and cloud training.

result.description:
Dunsteel Engineering Pty Ltd

Location - Moss Vale NSW

Dunsteel Engineering Pty Ltd is a leading steel fabrication business with over 50 years of experience. We specialise in delivering complex projects for leading building firms and architects. Dunsteel are at the forefront of prefabricated stairway design for large multistorey buildings. We are currently seeking to fill the position of Welder who will be responsible for:

Main task:
Read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and standards to establish the job requirements.
Plan the work sequence accordingly.
Select and prepare metal stock.
Carry out trial fits for mechanical/structural assemblies.
Conduct welding operations to build armoured steel welded assemblies in accordance with the Drawings, Quality Standards and Safety requirements.
Finish product by cleaning, polishing, filing, or bathing in acid solutions, or by applying protective or decorative coatings.
Exam, use and maintain tools and equipment safely.
Maintaining appropriate stock levels of spare parts
Conduct quality checks to ensure welded components meet industry standards and project specifications.

Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications:
Relevant Trade Qualification
At least 2 years relevant experience
Strong proficiency in Mig welding techniques and processes.
Knowledge of welding equipment and tools, and ability to perform routine maintenance.
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and quality in work.
Work Health Safety (WHS) knowledge

Salary Range
$75,000-$85,000 annually

Position
Full Time

If you meet the above criteria please apply now, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
Lead enterprise AI strategy, architecture, and delivery across transformative digital initiatives.   Your new company   Join a forward-thinking organisation undergoing a significant digital and data transformation journey. With a strong focus on innovation, emerging technologies, and data-driven decision-making, this organisation is investing in modern AI, analytics, and digital platforms to enhance business outcomes and create long-term value. You will be part of a collaborative environment where technology plays a critical role in shaping future capabilities across the enterprise.    Your new role     
 As the Technical Lead - AI, you will provide both strategic direction and hands-on leadership across enterprise AI, data, analytics, intelligent automation, and digital platform initiatives. Acting as the key link between business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams, you will drive the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and business-aligned solutions. 
 You will lead the development of enterprise AI and data platforms, define future-state architecture, establish trusted data foundations, and guide the implementation of modern integration and automation capabilities. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will facilitate technical workshops, influence technology roadmaps, and ensure delivery outcomes align with organisational objectives. 
 In addition, you will mentor development teams, promote engineering best practices, and provide governance across solution design, cybersecurity, Responsible AI, and enterprise architecture standards. 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate: 
 
 Proven experience leading complex AI, data, digital transformation, or enterprise technology programs. 
 Strong hands-on expertise in software engineering, solution architecture, and cloud-based platform delivery. 
 Experience designing and implementing AI and data solutions leveraging technologies such as AWS, Snowflake, Cortex AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, and Agent-based solutions. 
 Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture, semantic modelling, canonical data structures, API and integration architecture, governance, and security frameworks. 
 Ability to define technology strategy, future-state architecture, and scalable solution roadmaps. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and business decision-makers. 
 Experience mentoring technical teams and driving high standards of delivery, operational readiness, and continuous improvement. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 In return, you will have the opportunity to lead enterprise-scale AI and digital transformation initiatives within a progressive and innovation-focused environment. You will play a key role in shaping technology strategy, influencing architectural direction, and delivering solutions that create measurable business impact. 
 You'll benefit from working alongside experienced professionals, exposure to emerging technologies, and the ability to make a lasting contribution to the organisation's future digital capabilities. 
  What you need to do now     
 If you're interested in this role, click  'apply now'  to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.  Please  click here  to apply.
